caveat: Agreement is not correctness. Models trained on overlapping corpora are not independent coders, so high agreement bounds how much the single-model insights can be blamed on one model's idiosyncrasy — it says nothing about whether the mechanism is true of real users. Disagreement, by contrast, is decisive.
